title: When the Wolf Breaks Revisited
author: Oscar Coldharbour
blurb: Juniper Okonkwo, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
